items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Charlie Truth's reputation, but the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or statement indicating a direct personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: And Doc Randall used to say, Marge has got the best left hand that come in here, because Marge used to set in sing and play with us sometimes, you know. And he loved the way Marge played that bass you know, that walking bass, you know. That was real St. Louis style, you know.
We'll get to talk about that in a minute. We'll give you a little pause while you think up some other things. Well, Charlie truth though, he had a big reputation around then too.
Yes, he did. Yes, he did. He -- and he was a big man on Dago Hill.
